evidence: Cod. Just.; Ambros. (Lewis & Short, s.v. scaenicus)
Cod. Th. 7.16.41 (Lewis & Short): a female plaintiff
terms.comment: Lewis & Short gives only “female plaintiff” and “stewardess”; for an actress, scaenica.

sources: Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio: s.v. actress.
